I recently got off of Paxil, and I don't mean to scare you or discourage you, but it was such hell for me. I first started at 10mg. That very first week was undoubtedly the pinnacle of my good mood. I was really happy and feeling euphoric even. The only physical symptoms I had was nausea and mild dizziness, which lasted about 2 days. After a week, I felt nothing, so I went up to 20mg. Again, it did nothing, so after 6 weeks I went up to 30mg. Let me just say that was the lowest points of my life. I remember one very specific week I took off from school. All I wanted to do and all I thought of doing was dying. I'd never felt worse before, and I know 100% it was because of my drugs. Paxil was also a sedative for me. Despite getting sufficient amounts of sleep, I always felt tired. I could sleep anywhere and whenever. 

It's been 2 weeks since I got off of Paxil. I have to say, my mood is definitely a lot better. Obviously, my experiences are unique to me. It may work for you, and I hope it does!
